prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add an `import-csv` command requiring `--path`. CSV rows require a nonblank `Title`; `Description` is optional and `Status` may be blank, `pending`, or `completed`. Validate the entire file before changing storage, import valid rows with unique sequential IDs, and leave storage untouched if any row is invalid. Support `--json` with a stable summary containing imported count and IDs. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/import.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON imports display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `IMPORT`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Valid rows import with a stable count.
Text import renders the exact registered banner once before its expected count result.
asset must use LF line endings
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.

+            Assert-KnownOptions -Options $options -Allowed @('path', 'data-file', 'json')

+            $rows = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $csvPath)
+            $validatedRows = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()

+            for ($index = 0; $index -lt $rows.Count; $index++) {
+                $row = $rows[$index]

+                $title = if ($null -eq $titleProperty) { '' } else { [string]$titleProperty.Value }
+                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($title)) {
+                    throw "CSV row $($index + 1) requires a nonblank Title."
+                }
+
+                $statusProperty = $row.PSObject.Properties['Status']
+                $status = if ($null -eq $statusProperty) { '' } else { ([string]$statusProperty.Value).Trim() }
+                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($status)) {
+                    $status = 'pending'
+                }
+                elseif ($status -notin @('pending', 'completed')) {
+                    throw "CSV row $($index + 1) has invalid Status '$status'."
+                }
+
+                $descriptionProperty = $row.PSObject.Properties['Description']
+                $validatedRows.Add([pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                    title = $title.Trim()
+                    description = if ($null -eq $descriptionProperty) { '' } else { [string]$descriptionProperty.Value }
+                    status = $status
+                })
+            }
+
+            $tasks = @(Read-TaskStore -Path $dataFile)
+            $nextId = if ($tasks.Count -eq 0) { 1 } else { 1 + [int](($tasks | Measure-Object -Property id -Maximum).Maximum) }
+            $importedTasks = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
+            foreach ($row in $validatedRows) {
+                $importedTasks.Add([pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                    id = $nextId++
+                    title = $row.title
+                    description = $row.description
+                    status = $row.status
+                    createdAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
+                })
+            }
+
+            if ($importedTasks.Count -gt 0) {
+                Write-TaskStore -Path $dataFile -Tasks @($tasks + $importedTasks)
+            }
+
+            $ids = @($importedTasks | ForEach-Object { $_.id })
+            $summary = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                importedCount = $importedTasks.Count
+                ids = $ids
+            }
+            if ($asJson) {
+                Write-TaskForgeOutput -Value $summary -AsJson $true
+            }
+            else {
+                Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/import.txt')
+                "Imported $($summary.importedCount) task(s). IDs: $($ids -join ', ')"
+            }
+        }
         'list' {
             Assert-KnownOptions -Options $options -Allowed @('data-file', 'json')
             $tasks = @(Read-TaskStore -Path $dataFile | Sort-Object { [int]$_.id })

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $csvPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.csv'
    @'
Title,Description,Status
Imported pending,First imported task,
Imported complete,,completed
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $csvPath -Encoding utf8

    $import = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $csvPath, '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($import.ExitCode -eq 0) 'import-csv should succeed for valid rows'
    $imported = $import.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (
        $imported.importedCount -eq 2 -and
        ($imported.ids -join ',') -eq '1,2' -and
        $import.Output -eq '{"importedCount":2,"ids":[1,2]}'
    ) 'JSON import summary should have stable count and sequential IDs without a banner'

    $importedTasks = @((Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')).Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (
        $importedTasks.Count -eq 2 -and
        $importedTasks[0].status -eq 'pending' -and
        $importedTasks[1].status -eq 'completed' -and
        $importedTasks[1].description -eq ''
    ) 'import-csv should normalize blank status and optional description'

    $secondCsvPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'more-tasks.csv'
    "Title`nThird task" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $secondCsvPath -Encoding utf8
    $textImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $secondCsvPath, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/import.txt'
    $banner = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath) -join "`n"
    $expectedTextImport = "$banner`nImported 1 task(s). IDs: 3"
    Assert-True (
        $textImport.ExitCode -eq 0 -and
        $textImport.Output -ceq $expectedTextImport
    ) 'non-JSON import should display the banner once and report the next ID'

    $beforeInvalidImport = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $invalidCsvPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid-tasks.csv'
    @'
Title,Description,Status
Valid row,Would otherwise import,pending
Invalid status,,started
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $invalidCsvPath -Encoding utf8
    $invalidImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $invalidCsvPath, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $afterInvalidImport = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    Assert-True (
        $invalidImport.ExitCode -ne 0 -and
        $beforeInvalidImport -ceq $afterInvalidImport
    ) 'an invalid row should reject the entire CSV without changing storage'

    $missingTitleCsvPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'missing-title.csv'
    "Description,Status`nMissing title,pending" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $missingTitleCsvPath -Encoding utf8
    $missingTitle = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $missingTitleCsvPath, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True (
        $missingTitle.ExitCode -ne 0 -and
        $beforeInvalidImport -ceq (Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw)
    ) 'every CSV row should require a nonblank Title'

    $missingPath = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingPath.ExitCode -ne 0) 'import-csv should require --path'

    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerText = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bannerBytes)
    $bannerLines = $bannerText -split "`n"
    $validBannerLines = $bannerLines.Count -eq 13 -and $bannerLines[-1] -eq ''
    foreach ($line in @($bannerLines | Select-Object -First 12)) {
        $line = $line.TrimEnd("`r")
        $validBannerLines = $validBannerLines -and
            $line.Length -ge 20 -and $line.Length -le 48 -and
            $line -cmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*\.#():=-]+$' -and
            $line -cnotmatch '\s$'
    }
    Assert-True (
        $validBannerLines -and
        $bannerText.Contains('IMPORT') -and
        @($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0
    ) 'import banner should satisfy the exact asset constraints'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True (
        $help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and
        $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge') -and
        $help.Output.Contains('import-csv --path PATH')
    ) 'help should include import-csv'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 16 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
